files.description: Shop price list (64 rows): sku (text code such as "PL-0007"), item (product name with size; several names have accented letters), section (dairy, pantry, drinks or bakery; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), price (written with exactly two decimals, e.g. "9.50"; no empty cells).

task_text: Clean the price list: in every text column remove the spaces around the values and convert the text to lower case. Then compute the average price per section, rounded to two decimals. `result` should be a Series indexed by section.
intended_computation: Read price_list.csv, strip and lower-case the text columns (section is the one that matters: dairy, pantry, drinks, bakery), group by the cleaned section and return the mean price per section rounded to 2 decimals (4 sections).

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the type test finds no text column, so section labels keep their spaces and capitals and split into 12 groups

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
